name: David Chen
psychographics: Values efficiency above all else; hates waste but will splurge on convenience to save time on weekday mornings.
current_solutions: Google Calendar shared with partner; Cozi family organizer app; Ocado grocery delivery.
frustration: Tried to book after-school care at 8:15 AM on Tuesday - the portal crashed, showing a blank white screen for 20 minutes, causing me to be 22 minutes late for a client call.
decision_style: Reads verified reviews on Which? for 3-4 days, then buys the highest-rated option without comparing prices further.
voice: Blunt and direct; cuts to the chase, rarely apologizes for being abrupt.
